question: What is today's total gross revenue?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TodaySales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: Use XnDt (date column) and MrpValue (gross revenue) from VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. XnNo is the invoice/bill number.

question: What is MTD gross revenue?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS MTDSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: MTD = 1st of current month to today. Use MrpValue for gross revenue, XnDt for date.

question: What is YTD gross revenue?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS YTDSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(
    CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 END,
    4, 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: YTD uses Indian FY starting April 1. MrpValue = gross revenue. XnDt = sale date.

question: What is QTD gross revenue?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS QTDSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= CASE
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (4,5,6)    THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 4,  1)
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (7,8,9)    THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7,  1)
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (10,11,12) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 10, 1)
    ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1)
  END
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
note: QTD uses Indian FY quarters: Q1=Apr-Jun, Q2=Jul-Sep, Q3=Oct-Dec, Q4=Jan-Mar.

question: Show top 5 branches by gross revenue this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 5
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
note: BranchAlias is the store/location name. MrpValue = gross revenue. Never use BranchId or BranchName.

question: Gross revenue by all branches this month
sql:
SELECT
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
note: All branches ranked by MrpValue (gross revenue). BranchAlias is the display name.

question: Compare this month vs last month sales by branch
sql:
SELECT
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
     AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
    THEN [MrpValue] ELSE 0 END) AS ThisMonth,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(MONTH,-1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
     AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <  DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
    THEN [MrpValue] ELSE 0 END) AS LastMonth
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(MONTH,-1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY ThisMonth DESC
note: Side-by-side MTD vs prior full month using conditional SUM on MrpValue.

question: What is the daily sales trend this month?
sql:
SELECT
  CAST([XnDt] AS date) AS SaleDate,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY CAST([XnDt] AS date)
ORDER BY SaleDate
note: Day-by-day trend for current month. XnDt is the sale date. MrpValue = gross revenue.

question: Show monthly sales trend for last 6 months
sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date)), '-', RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date)) AS varchar(2)), 2)) AS Month,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date)), MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date))
ORDER BY YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date)), MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date))
note: Last 6 months trend. Use CONCAT for yyyy-mm label for correct chronological ordering.

question: Top 10 salespersons by gross revenue this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [SupplierName] AS Salesperson,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [SupplierName]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
note: SupplierName = salesperson/staff name in this installation. MrpValue = gross revenue.

question: Top 10 articles by quantity sold this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [ArticleNo] AS Article,
  MAX([Color]) AS Color,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [ArticleNo]
ORDER BY TotalQty DESC
note: ArticleNo = product code (APP_REPORT has no ArticleName). AppQty = quantity sold.

question: Top 20 highest selling articles all time by gross revenue
sql:
SELECT TOP 20
  [ArticleNo] AS Article,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
GROUP BY [ArticleNo]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
note: All-time ranking — no date filter needed. TOP 20 articles by MrpValue across entire history.

question: Yesterday's gross revenue by branch
sql:
SELECT
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
note: Yesterday = DATEADD(day,-1, today). BranchAlias = store name. MrpValue = gross revenue.

question: Top 10 vendors by purchase amount this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [SupplierName] AS Vendor,
  SUM(ISNULL([NetPurNetAmount], 0)) AS TotalPurchase
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [SupplierName]
HAVING SUM(ISNULL([NetPurNetAmount], 0)) > 0
ORDER BY TotalPurchase DESC
note: Purchase amount: VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT.NetPurNetAmount (not MrpValue on PUR_REPORT — that view has PurQty only). SupplierName = vendor.

question: Top 10 highest sales invoices today
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [XnNo] AS InvoiceNo,
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  [SupplierName] AS Salesperson,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS InvoiceTotal,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS Qty
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [XnNo], [BranchAlias], [SupplierName]
ORDER BY InvoiceTotal DESC
note: XnNo = invoice/bill number. BranchAlias = store. SupplierName = salesperson.
